{{Top|leg}}
'''Ah'Kra''', not to be confused with [[Kra]], was a city located on the planet of [[Coyn]]. The [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] Ah'Kra'Tais or "Common-craftersland" was located in this city as well. Ah'kra was noted for its excellent medical, repair and resupply services.
